chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Kuleyb al-Saydawi, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
Link (with each other), and do good and be compassionate, and become righteous brothers just as Allah Mighty and Majestic Commanded (you all to be).

key_terms.إِخْوَةً بَرَرَةً: Righteous brothers; pious siblings in faith
key_terms.تَبَارُّوا: Do good to one another; exchange kindness
key_terms.تَرَاحَمُوا: Be compassionate to one another; show mercy
key_terms.تَوَاصَلُوا: Link with each other; maintain ties of kinship and community
key_terms.عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ: Mighty and Majestic; honorific for Allah

ai.seo_question: What does the Imam mean by being 'righteous brothers' in Shia ethics?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) links social cohesion directly to divine obedience, urging believers to cultivate brotherhood through active compassion (*tarahhum*) and mutual kindness (*tabarr*). This instruction reflects the Shia emphasis on *silat al-arham* (maintaining kinship ties) not merely as a social courtesy, but as a spiritual imperative that mirrors the unity of the faithful community.
